who.value: seller with paid orders to fulfil, likely Pro/high-volume

job.value: see which orders need action and confirm or arrange delivery

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'My sales' with the 'To start' tab and a table of orders with 'Ship out by 9 Sep 2026' makes the job clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The bold 'Ship out by …' deadlines stand out, but the actions that do the job (Confirm order, Arrange delivery) are hidden behind each row's '⋮' menu.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Tabs, 'Date' and 'Deal Method' filters are clear, but the per-row chat bubble and '⋮' icons carry no label.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Deal method', 'Custom delivery' and 'Earnings' are terms a seller already uses.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The screen asks only which order to act on and how to filter, which the seller knows.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: An 'Order ID' column of truncated UUIDs ('O3920b66c-b079-4d3…') takes prime width, while the actions are tucked away.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The 'Get 500 free coins (S$5 value) … Subscribe' upsell banner sits under the order table, a marketing moment on a fulfilment screen.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Columns of values (title, buyer, earnings, status) carry the screen with no explanatory text.
